problem: Consider the matrix given by $L=[\begin{aligned}8 & -1 \\ 2 & -2 \\ 1 & 1\end{aligned}].$ Determine the value of $k$ for which the vector $b=[\begin{aligned}7k-1 \\ -2 \\ 3\end{aligned}]$ belongs to $\text{Col}(L).$
worked_solution:
If $b$ lies in $\text{Col}(L),$ then the equation $Lx=b$ must be consistent. So, let's find the row echelon form of the augmented matrix $[L\,|\,b]$ as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}[L\,|\,b] & =[\begin{aligned}8 & -1 & 7k-1 \\ 2 & -2 & -2 \\ 1 & 1 & 3\end{aligned}] & {R}_{1} & ↔{R}_{3} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 1 & 3 \\ 2 & -2 & -2 \\ 8 & -1 & 7k-1\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :={R}_{2}-2{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 1 & 3 \\ 0 & -4 & -8 \\ 8 & -1 & 7k-1\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}-8{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 1 & 3 \\ 0 & -4 & -8 \\ 0 & -9 & 7k-25\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :=(-\frac{1}{4}){R}_{2} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 1 & 3 \\ 0 & 1 & 2 \\ 0 & -9 & 7k-25\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+9{R}_{2} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 1 & 3 \\ 0 & 1 & 2 \\ 0 & 0 & 7k-7\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

So, we have the system

$$
{\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}+{x}_{2}=3 \\ {x}_{2}=2 \\ 0=7k-7.\end{aligned}
$$

In order for this system to be consistent, we require $0=7k-7,$ which means that $k=1.$
